title: Item, Weapon, Armor, Tool & Equipment Engineering Adapter Pack
objective: Implement ordinary Item/weapon/armor/tool/equipment engineering adapters over PPIA-03/D17/MIB-12/MRCS that preserve Asset identity/history, route all mutations through canonical owners, consume explicit compatibility/modularity definitions, and expose MERA inspection/proposal/repair/test affordances without creating a second Item, crafting, inventory or equipment-definition system.
acceptance: Ordinary Item/equipment engineering projections preserve D17 Asset identity, owner version and history references.
Install/remove/repair/modify operations remain typed owner requests to D17/MIB-12 and are never committed by MERA itself.
Weapon/armor/tool modularity and slot/compatibility behavior comes only from explicit MRCS/owner definitions.
Name, category or visual similarity cannot create compatibility or interchangeable slots.
Unknown or conflicting compatibility/modularity remains unresolved and fails closed for operations requiring it.
Recovered/substitute parts preserve LSS/D17 provenance and do not become anonymous MERA inventory.
Equipment/loadout projections remain projections of owner state rather than a parallel inventory/equipment ledger.
MERA-01/03/05/06/07/10 affordances compose without changing their owner boundaries.
Blocking Item/equipment engineering remains semantic/nonvisual and provider-off.
boundaries: PPIA-03/D17 retain Item/Asset identity, ownership, custody, condition, installation/modification and history.
LSS retains recovered-part/donor provenance and recoverability.
GPR + Action/Event retain generic execution/replay and owner-operation receipt semantics.
MERA creates no second inventory, equipment, crafting or item-definition ledger.
MERA-13+ vehicle/mecha/starship adapter work remains unauthorized.
MBES remains blocked until MERA completes at MERA-24.
next_action: MERA-12 is completed_verified. MERA-13 — Vehicle, Mecha & Starship Engineering Adapter Pack — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
